inputs.name: gate_ramp_days
inputs.rationale: New obligations first affect successive checkpoints; smooth rollout is a fluid approximation, not observed enactment effect.

inputs.name: first_training_effect_days
inputs.rationale: Already trained models remain available; an authorization gate affects subsequent checkpoints after a training pipeline delay.

inputs.name: one_time_release_recovery_days
inputs.rationale: A one-time release engineering hold ceases to constrain later releases; no repeated annual charge.

inputs.name: reverse_spillover
inputs.rationale: Small but nonzero U.S. reliance on marginal Chinese frontier research/models, including open weights. No identified national elasticity.

inputs.name: china_pause_relative_exposure
inputs.rationale: Universal-pause sensitivity: Chinese capability lost relative to U.S. direct loss, allowing different binding thresholds and adaptation.

notes: All national effects use a representative frontier production path with broad jurisdictional coverage. There is no fitted multi-lab maximum or causal policy panel.
At 36months postyear1 resource assumptions persist unless a policy expires; these are scenario sensitivities.
